entries.title: Psalms 104:1
segments: ¶Bless the LORD, O my soul. O LORD my God, thou art very great; thou art clothed with honour and majesty.

entries.title: Psalms 104:2
segments: Who coverest [thyself] with light as [with] a garment: who stretchest out the heavens like a curtain:

entries.title: Psalms 104:3
segments: Who layeth the beams of his chambers in the waters: who maketh the clouds his chariot: who walketh upon the wings of the wind:

entries.title: Psalms 104:4
segments: Who maketh his angels spirits; his ministers a flaming fire:

entries.title: Psalms 104:5
segments: [Who] laid the foundations of the earth, [that] it should not be removed for ever. {Who...: Heb. He hath founded the earth upon her bases}

words.text: . {Who...: Heb. He hath founded the earth upon her bases}

entries.title: Psalms 104:6
segments: Thou coveredst it with the deep as [with] a garment: the waters stood above the mountains.

entries.title: Psalms 104:7
segments: At thy rebuke they fled; at the voice of thy thunder they hasted away.

entries.title: Psalms 104:8
segments: They go up by the mountains; they go down by the valleys unto the place which thou hast founded for them. {They go up...: or, The mountains ascend, the valleys descend}

words.text: for them. {They go up...: or, The mountains ascend, the valleys descend}

entries.title: Psalms 104:9
segments: Thou hast set a bound that they may not pass over; that they turn not again to cover the earth.

words.text: that they may not pass over

entries.title: Psalms 104:10
segments: ¶He sendeth the springs into the valleys, [which] run among the hills. {He: Heb. Who} {run: Heb. walk}

entries.title: Psalms 104:11
segments: They give drink to every beast of the field: the wild asses quench their thirst. {quench: Heb. break}

entries.title: Psalms 104:12
segments: By them shall the fowls of the heaven have their habitation, [which] sing among the branches. {sing: Heb. give a voice}

entries.title: Psalms 104:13
segments: He watereth the hills from his chambers: the earth is satisfied with the fruit of thy works.

entries.title: Psalms 104:14
segments: He causeth the grass to grow for the cattle, and herb for the service of man: that he may bring forth food out of the earth;

entries.title: Psalms 104:15
segments: And wine [that] maketh glad the heart of man, [and] oil to make [his] face to shine, and bread [which] strengtheneth man's heart. {oil...: Heb. to make his face shine with oil, or, more than oil}

words.text: . {oil...: Heb. to make his face shine with oil, or, more than oil}

entries.title: Psalms 104:16
segments: The trees of the LORD are full [of sap]; the cedars of Lebanon, which he hath planted;

entries.title: Psalms 104:17
segments: Where the birds make their nests: [as for] the stork, the fir trees [are] her house.

entries.title: Psalms 104:18
segments: The high hills [are] a refuge for the wild goats; [and] the rocks for the conies.

entries.title: Psalms 104:19
segments: ¶He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth his going down.

entries.title: Psalms 104:20
segments: Thou makest darkness, and it is night: wherein all the beasts of the forest do creep [forth]. {beasts...: Heb. beasts thereof do trample on the forest}

words.text: [forth]. {beasts...: Heb. beasts thereof do trample on the forest}

entries.title: Psalms 104:21
segments: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their meat from God.

entries.title: Psalms 104:22
segments: The sun ariseth, they gather themselves together, and lay them down in their dens.

entries.title: Psalms 104:23
segments: Man goeth forth unto his work and to his labour until the evening.

entries.title: Psalms 104:24
segments: O LORD, how manifold are thy works! in wisdom hast thou made them all: the earth is full of thy riches.

entries.title: Psalms 104:25
segments: [So is] this great and wide sea, wherein [are] things creeping innumerable, both small and great beasts.

entries.title: Psalms 104:26
segments: There go the ships: [there is] that leviathan, [whom] thou hast made to play therein. {made: Heb. formed}

entries.title: Psalms 104:27
segments: These wait all upon thee; that thou mayest give [them] their meat in due season.

words.text: all upon thee; that thou mayest give

entries.title: Psalms 104:28
segments: [That] thou givest them they gather: thou openest thine hand, they are filled with good.

entries.title: Psalms 104:29
segments: Thou hidest thy face, they are troubled: thou takest away their breath, they die, and return to their dust.

entries.title: Psalms 104:30
segments: Thou sendest forth thy spirit, they are created: and thou renewest the face of the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 104:31
segments: ¶The glory of the LORD shall endure for ever: the LORD shall rejoice in his works. {endure: Heb. be}

entries.title: Psalms 104:32
segments: He looketh on the earth, and it trembleth: he toucheth the hills, and they smoke.

entries.title: Psalms 104:33
segments: I will sing unto the LORD as long as I live: I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.

entries.title: Psalms 104:34
segments: My meditation of him shall be sweet: I will be glad in the LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 104:35
segments: Let the sinners be consumed out of the earth, and let the wicked be no more. Bless thou the LORD, O my soul. Praise ye the LORD.
